newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt offers stake in tourism firm for sale.
newsitem.headline: Egypt offers stake in tourism firm for sale.

text.p: The Egyptian government said on Sunday it was offering its whole stake in New Ismailia Investment and Tourism Company for sale through sealed bids.

The state-owned Holding Company for Housing, Cinema and Tourism said in a published statement it was offering the sale of 28.46 percent, or 284,630 shares, in New Ismailia to individuals and institutional investors. No price was set.
Its subsidiary Misr Hotels holds the stake, the holding company said.
The closing date for the offer is August 14 at noon.
